mentions.name: libzim-website-converter
mentions.description: A website archive tool for watching websites offline. It collects a website and converts it into a .Zim archive (equivalent of a .zip), which can then be viewed when there is no internet access or only a local network. It is built on libzim to provide an easy-to-use way to create custom ZIM archives.
mentions.problem: The author did not find "easy to use" tools for creating custom archives with libzim.
mentions.audience: Personal use: watching archived websites offline when there is no internet access or only a local network
